reason: The reviewer read the diff direction backwards (ZodNumberFormat was never generic before, so the "now fails as not generic" sub-claim is wrong), but the substantive defect it describes — `ZodInt`/`ZodInt32`/etc. all extend a non-parameterized `ZodNumberFormat` so `_zod.def.format` is the full `$ZodNumberFormats` union with no literal narrowing — is exactly the state of the BEFORE code and precisely the bug the linked issue and commit fix.
